title: Kontrole, rizik i upravljanje ranjivostima
summary: Tipovi kontrola (administrative, technical, physical) i funkcije (preventative, detective, responsive, corrective), inherent i residual rizik, risk appetite, strategije accept/transfer/avoid/mitigate, politike, governance i SLO rokovi ispravke, SAST, DAST, OWASP SAMM i rizik trećih strana (supply chain, SCA, SBOM, VEX).
summary_en: Control types (administrative, technical, physical) and functions (preventative, detective, responsive, corrective), inherent and residual risk, risk appetite, accept/transfer/avoid/mitigate strategies, policies, governance, and remediation SLOs, SAST, DAST, OWASP SAMM, and third-party risk (supply chain, SCA, SBOM, VEX).
